summary: Of 20 base retail/other records, only three unique entities qualify as executed Raleigh retail leases inside the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window and 8-mile radius with positive rent and known term, free rent, TI (and a known expense deduction for gross leases). Ranked by distance then lease date: R5361 (ELM-REN-25776, 0.80 mi, 2026-02-05, $21.00 face, $11.28/sf/yr effective, 36 mo); R8528 (ELM-REN-95631, 1.03 mi, 2026-03-06, $22.44 face, $16.93/sf/yr effective, 48 mo, amended free rent 4 mo / TI 18 per U-R8528-1); R4908 (ELM-REN-51407, 1.26 mi, 2026-04-07, $22.60 face, $19.41/sf/yr effective, 60 mo). Average effective net rent across the three is $15.87/sf/yr. Four otherwise-plausible comps (R5055, R7763, R3778, R8329) were removed by executed amendments reclassifying them to Office; R4617 and the R4908 rent amendment are post-cutoff; R6572 is a duplicate of R5361's entity and does not take a second slot. No SPV-to-parent mappings were present in the packet. Comp-grid workbook created with live formulas (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).
limitations: Convention is undiscounted and rent-only (no discounting, no percentage rent, no commissions, no downtime); results are not a market appraisal.
Gross expense deductions rely on the stated annual_expenses_psf ($6.25) held flat over the term; no escalation of operating expenses is modeled.
Only three qualified comps survived screening, all NNN except R5361, so the gross-vs-NNN mix limits comparability and the $15.87 average is thin.
Records with null expense, term, TI, free-rent or rent fields were treated as unknown and excluded rather than defaulted to zero; some may qualify if the missing data were supplied.
U-R4908-2 (rent_quote 2, effective 2026-09-10) and S-R4617 (published 2026-09-03) are post-cutoff; if they become effective evidence, R4908's rent basis and the R4617 comp would need re-evaluation.
Distances and areas are taken as given in the extracts; no independent geocoding or unit verification was possible, and 'USD_per_sf_month' quotes were annualized by x12.
R6572 vs R5361 duplication is inferred from identical entity_id and lease terms; if they were in fact separate leases, an additional comp would exist.
